transaction hash: Transaction identifier — a string that uniquely identifies a transaction on the blockchain.
ledger: Ledger — a block/page of the blockchain record.
fee: Fee — amount paid to the blockchain network to process the transaction.
memo: Memo — optional text attached to the transaction.
status: Status — the transaction outcome as reported by the source (success/failed).
amount: Amount — quantity of the asset transferred.
asset: Asset — the currency or token (e.g. PI).
source: Source — where the data came from.
hash: Hash — unique identifier of the transaction.
createdAt: Created at — time the transaction was recorded (if provided).
